title: What if you were trapped in a supermarket for 30 days during a zombie apocalypse?
formula: Strange act -> why (zombies hunt by sound) -> weird preparation with a doubter (Dave) -> break-in -> the plan fires -> reversal (cart jams on a bean can, 400 heads turn back) -> Dave's forbidden duck saves it -> chase -> 4-word kicker
facts: Many toddler toys play sounds when shaken (motion switches); with the batteries out they are silent (real-world logic, no source needed).
Zombies hunting by sound: genre convention, played straight as the world's one rule.
Dogs chase a thrown ball: everyday analogy, no source needed.

lines.narration: You pull the batteries out of 212 talking *toys*.
lines.spoken: You pull the batteries out of two hundred and twelve talking toys.
lines.scene: Cold open, toy aisle under flickering fluorescent light: you kneel in a mountain of plush ducks, dinosaurs and robots, popping a battery out of a duck mid-quack. A hand-painted 'AISLE 9 TOYS' sign hangs above you.
lines.camera: Low angle push-in through a gap in the shelf
lines.gag: Each toy freezes mid-word, mouth open, the moment its battery pops out

lines.narration: Because outside, 400 zombies are waiting, and they hunt by *sound*.
lines.spoken: Because outside, four hundred zombies are waiting, and they hunt by sound.
lines.scene: Fly back through the store and out the front glass: the parking lot packed with green-grey zombies, every head tilted, listening. Pale day sky.
lines.camera: Fast pull-out with motion blur, through the doors to an extreme wide
lines.gag: Hundreds of heads tilt the same way at the same time, like birds

lines.narration: One squeaky toy, and you're *lunch*.
lines.scene: Back inside: a single plush duck on the floor; your hand hovers over it. Behind the glass, one zombie licks its lips.
lines.camera: Insert close-up on the duck, slow creep-in

lines.narration: The only other person in here is Dave from the night shift. He thinks you've *lost it*.
lines.scene: Dave peeks over a shelf of cereal: teen stocker, tall messy hair, green store vest, name tag 'DAVE', braces. He watches you tape a toy's mouth shut.
lines.camera: Glide along the cereal shelf to Dave
lines.gag: Dave's name tag is upside down

lines.narration: Then it gets weirder. You tape every toy to one cart, until it looks like a *hedgehog*.
lines.scene: Night, blue window light and a green exit sign: a shopping cart bristling with 212 taped-on toys, arms and tails sticking out every way.
lines.camera: Slow orbit around the cart
lines.gag: A dinosaur's tail sticks straight up like a flag

lines.narration: You park it at the top of the loading ramp, under a sign: do not *push*.
lines.scene: Back of the store, loading dock doors. You hang a cardboard sign above the cart, hand-written 'DO NOT PUSH'. The ramp slopes down toward the dock doors.
lines.camera: Tilt down from the sign to the cart
lines.gag: The sign is drawn with a crayon from the toy aisle

lines.narration: Dave whispers, "Can I keep the duck?" You say *no*.
lines.spoken: Dave whispers, "Can I keep the duck?" [deadpan] You say no.
lines.scene: Dave holds the plush duck to his cheek, big pleading eyes. You take it and drop it in the toy bin.
lines.camera: Two-shot, push-in on Dave's face
lines.gag: Dave's eyes go huge and shiny

lines.narration: So for weeks, you live on cold beans and *whispers*.
lines.scene: Montage in one shot: you and Dave on a pallet eating beans out of cans, mouthing words, tiptoeing in socks; empty bean cans pile up by the ramp. Calendar on the wall flips by.
lines.camera: Slow lateral glide past the two of you
lines.gag: You both eat beans with your pinkies to stay quiet

lines.narration: Then Dave sneezes once, and every zombie outside turns at the same *time*.
lines.scene: Dave's sneeze (cartoon spray). Cut outside: 400 heads snap toward the store at once.
lines.camera: Hard cut from Dave's face to an extreme wide of the lot
lines.gag: 400 heads snap in perfect sync

lines.narration: On day 29, the weirdest thing yet. You put every battery back *in*.
lines.spoken: On day twenty-nine, the weirdest thing yet. You put every battery back in.
lines.scene: Moonlight: you sliding a battery into a dinosaur like a bomb squad, tongue out, sweat drop; Dave holding a flashlight with both hands, horrified.
lines.camera: Slow push-in, shallow focus on the battery
lines.gag: Bomb-squad sweat drop; Dave's flashlight shakes

lines.narration: Very, very *gently*.
lines.scene: Extreme close-up: the battery clicks home; the dinosaur's eye twitches but it stays silent.
lines.camera: Macro insert, creep-in

lines.narration: The next morning, the front glass cracks. Then it *bursts*.
lines.scene: Cold dawn. Spider cracks race across the doors; white flash; glass sprays inward (no one hurt on screen).
lines.camera: Impact kick, fast pull-back down the main aisle
lines.gag: The first zombie through the door is still wearing a 'Welcome!' greeter badge

lines.narration: They pour in, sniffing. Aisle one. Aisle two. Aisle *three*.
lines.spoken: They pour in, sniffing. Aisle one. Aisle two. [whispers] Aisle three.
lines.scene: Hanging aisle signs pass overhead as the horde shuffles deeper; you and Dave crouched behind the cart at the top of the ramp.
lines.camera: Overhead track along the aisle signs, ending on you two
lines.gag: Their stomachs growl so loud the aisle signs swing

lines.narration: So you kick the cart down the *ramp*,
lines.scene: Your boot hits the cart; the 'DO NOT PUSH' sign flutters off; the cart lurches down the ramp.
lines.camera: POV from the front of the cart, rushing down the ramp
lines.gag: The DO NOT PUSH sign flips over as it falls

lines.narration: and every bump makes 212 toys scream at *once*.
lines.spoken: and every bump makes two hundred and twelve toys scream at once.
lines.scene: The cart rattles; every toy yells, sings and roars; a glowing sound-trail streams behind it.
lines.camera: Fast side-on follow with motion blur
lines.gag: The cart leaves a glowing rainbow trail of music notes

lines.narration: You see, they only talk when they're shaken, and right now, that cart is the loudest thing in *town*.
lines.scene: Macro inserts while it rolls: a toy box printed 'SHAKE ME!', the tiny motion switch inside the duck-shaped hole where the duck used to be. In the aisles, 400 heads swing toward the cart.
lines.camera: Two quick macro inserts, then whip to the turning horde
lines.gag: Every box says 'SHAKE ME!'

lines.narration: Then it hits one empty bean can, and stops *dead*.
lines.scene: The front wheel jams on a single empty bean can at the bottom of the ramp, ten feet short of the dock doors. The cart stops. The rainbow trail fizzles out.
lines.camera: Low insert on the wheel and the can, hard stop
lines.gag: The can is from your bean pile

lines.narration: Not one toy makes a *sound*.
lines.scene: Total silence. Toys frozen mid-scream on the still cart.
lines.camera: Slow creep-in on the silent cart

lines.narration: And 400 heads turn back to *you*.
lines.spoken: And four hundred heads turn back to you.
lines.scene: The horde, packed in the aisles, slowly swivels its heads toward you and Dave at the top of the ramp. They start to shuffle closer, so close you can count their teeth.
lines.camera: Push down the aisle toward the two of you, the horde in the foreground
lines.gag: Every head turns in one slow, creaking sync

lines.narration: That's when Dave pulls something out of his pocket. The *duck*.
lines.scene: Close-up: Dave's vest pocket; the plush duck comes out. You stare at him. He shrugs, guilty.
lines.camera: Insert on the pocket, then push-in on Dave's guilty grin
lines.gag: Dave's guilty braces grin

lines.narration: He throws it. It smacks the cart, the cart jerks free, and every toy starts screaming *again*.
lines.scene: The duck spins through the air, bonks the hedgehog cart, the wheel pops off the can, the cart rolls on, toys screaming, and bursts out through the dock doors into bright morning.
lines.camera: Follow the duck's arc, then ride the cart out the doors into daylight
lines.gag: The duck quacks 'Shake me!' mid-air

lines.narration: And 400 zombies chase it like dogs after the loudest ball in the *world*.
lines.spoken: And four hundred zombies chase it like dogs after the loudest ball in the world.
lines.scene: The whole horde stampedes down the ramp and out across the lot after the cart, tongues out, arms up. You and Dave stand alone in the empty store.
lines.camera: Crane up from you two to an extreme wide of the stampede
lines.gag: One zombie's tongue flaps like a dog's

lines.narration: Dave wants his duck *back*.
lines.scene: Close-up: Dave staring after the cart, lower lip trembling; you beside him, one eyebrow up. The cart and horde tiny in the distance.
lines.camera: Push-in on Dave's face, end on the word
lines.gag: A single tear rolls down Dave's cheek
